text: Lightmatter's flagship product migrated away from its Envise inference accelerator toward which product, making it the cleanest example of the industry's compute-to-interconnect pivot?
choices: PennyLane, a quantum machine-learning software framework
TeraPHY, an in-package optical I/O chiplet
Passage, a wafer-scale programmable photonic interposer
Borealis, a time-multiplexed Gaussian boson sampling machine
explanation: Passage is Lightmatter's wafer-scale photonic interposer, the interconnect flagship it pivoted to from the Envise compute accelerator. TeraPHY is Ayar Labs' optical I/O chiplet, PennyLane is Xanadu's software, and Borealis is Xanadu's GBS machine, so the other options are all wrong company-product pairings.
